items: A CQL batch groups related writes. It is not automatically a faster bulk load across unrelated partitions.
`WHERE` keeps only rows that pass its condition. Check the condition with sample data before using it for a change.

blocks.text: Both changes target the same practice row in one partition.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Avoid huge cross-partition batches as a bulk-loading shortcut. Their coordination can add work.
